title: fix(memory): avoid unavailable session-search guidance
body:
Closes #147258

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: `memory_search` could recommend `sessions_search` even when the effective tool policy removed that capability.

## User Impact

User impact: semantic session-search guidance remains accurate without sending agents toward an unavailable tool. No configuration, migration, or stored-data change is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

The static `memory_search` description now explains the sessions corpus without naming another tool. Named `sessions_search` guidance remains in the final availability-aware memory prompt, where the effective tool inventory is known. When semantic session indexing is disabled, the result suggests an exact session-history capability conditionally and otherwise gives the operator enablement path.

## Evidence

- Source reproduction on original head `73d39fd0908dff9fed48041470a83ed9c61126e0`: a leaf subagent retained `memory_search` while policy denied `sessions_search`, but both the static description and unavailable result named `sessions_search` unconditionally.
- Focused tests: `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/memory-core/index.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/tools.test.ts src/agents/agent-tools.policy.test.ts` -> 120 tests passed.
- The registered Memory Core contract test now checks combined model-visible text and names `sessions_search` if and only if it exists in final `availableTools`.
- Targeted `oxfmt`, core `oxlint`, extension `oxlint`, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh diff-scoped autoreview through P2: no actionable findings.
- Local extension declaration/type wrappers were not run: their checkout-isolation guard rejects a nested worktree borrowing the owner clone's dependency install. Exact-head hosted CI is required before merge.

### Registered-tool after-fix proof

At exact head `dcdbb9833d3c9fde8c8ece130b9fa809c7c0bb4a`, a synthetic probe used the production Memory Core plugin registration path and instantiated its registered `memory_search` tool.

With final tools `memory_get`, `memory_search`, `sessions_history`, and `sessions_search`:

```text
description: `corpus=sessions` searches indexed session transcripts under the same visibility rules as session history tools and returns unavailable when semantic session indexing is disabled.
prompt: For session hits, use sessions_search ... then sessions_history ... for a bounded sanitized excerpt.
```

With final tools limited to `memory_get` and `memory_search`:

```text
prompt: Session hits are search snippets only; exact session history is unavailable with the enabled tools.
unavailable: true
error: Session transcript search is not enabled.
warning: Session transcript search is unavailable for this agent.
action: If an exact session-history capability is available for this run, use it. Otherwise, ask the operator to enable semantic session search by enabling memory.search.experimental.sessionMemory and adding "sessions" to memory.search.sources.
```

The probe used no real transcripts, user data, credentials, or external services.
